{{short description|Uruguayan professional football season}} The '''2005–06 season in the [[Uruguayan Primera División]]''' saw [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] defend and win a back-to-back-title by defeating the surprise of the championship, [[Rocha F.C.]], on two consecutive finals, thus winning their 41st title in Uruguayan football. Two teams were relegated, [[Deportivo Colonia]] and [[CA Cerro|Cerro]], but this time only one team, [[CA Progreso|Progreso]], was promoted. ==Overview== It was contested by 20 teams, and [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] won the championship. ==Apertura== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |team1=ROC|name_ROC=[[Rocha F.C.|Rocha]] |team2=NAC|name_NAC=[[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] |team3=DAN|name_DAN=[[Danubio F.C.|Danubio]] |team4=RAJ|name_RAJ=[[Rampla Juniors]] |team5=DCO|name_DCO=[[Deportivo Colonia]] |team6=CSC|name_CSC=[[Club Sportivo Cerrito|Cerrito]] |team7=PEÑ|name_PEÑ=[[C.A.
